title: Z-Anime: S3-DiT 6B High-Fidelity Anime Generation Model
summary: Z-Anime is a specialized image generation model fine-tuned from Alibaba's Z-Image (S3-DiT) architecture with 6 billion parameters. It delivers high-quality anime aesthetics and supports both traditional tag-based and natural language descriptive prompting.
research_notes: Features 6B parameters and S3-DiT architecture; includes specialized ComfyUI workflows and supports the Engineer V4 text encoder for improved output diversity.

evolution.summary: Originally a full fine-tune of Z-Image, the project evolved to include 4-step and 8-step distilled versions for rapid generation. Recent updates added GGUF quantizations, FP8 support for 8GB VRAM cards, and 'All-In-One' (AIO) safetensors for simplified use in ComfyUI and local apps.
